---
title: "Interactive Maps"
page-layout: full
toc: false
---

Explore Current Conditions, Daily History, or Monthly Climate with roads, terrain
or satellite backgrounds. Select a map, then click or tap a location for the
value of its original PRISM grid cell.

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple"}
Current Conditions shows each product's own date and period. Monthly Climate
follows the latest verified Monthly Climate release, with **1-, 3-, 6-
and 12-month periods**. Daily History shows the latest 30 days in the retained
data cache. Dates and reference periods follow the selection.
Recent PRISM data are preliminary and may be revised.
:::

[Open interactive maps full screen](../interactive-maps/index.html){.btn .btn-sm .btn-outline-primary}
[View Monthly Climate maps](monthly-climate.qmd){.btn .btn-sm .btn-outline-primary}

<iframe id="interactive-map-frame" src="../interactive-maps/index.html?embedded=1" title="Current conditions, daily history and monthly climate maps with source-cell values" style="width:100%;height:1450px;border:0;display:block" loading="eager"></iframe>

<script>
(() => {
  const frame = document.getElementById("interactive-map-frame");
  // An explicit no-basemap URL is useful for local offline/automated review.
  const requested = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get("basemap");
  if (["off", "none", "street", "terrain", "satellite"].includes(requested)) {
    const source = new URL(frame.src, window.location.href);
    source.searchParams.set("basemap", requested);
    frame.src = source.href;
  }
  let observer;
  frame.addEventListener("load", () => {
    observer?.disconnect();
    const body = frame.contentDocument?.body;
    if (!body) return;
    const resize = () => {
      const height = Math.max(550, Math.ceil(body.getBoundingClientRect().height) + 16);
      if (frame.style.height !== `${height}px`) frame.style.height = `${height}px`;
    };
    resize();
    observer = new ResizeObserver(resize);
    observer.observe(body);
  });
})();
</script>
